Class GlobalExceptionHandler

java.lang.Object
com.me.learning.framework.web.errors.GlobalExceptionHandler
@RestControllerAdvice public class GlobalExceptionHandler extends Object
Enterprise-wide REST exception handler.

Catches all exceptions thrown from any @RestController in the application and maps them to the standard ApiResponse envelope.

Logging strategy:

  • 4xx client errors → WARN (client problem, not ours)
  • 5xx server errors → ERROR with full stack trace

This class is registered as a Spring bean via SakilaFrameworkAutoConfiguration. Child services do NOT need to declare their own @ControllerAdvice.
